actual_reading.status: DONE — selected original NA energy and bounded model-ray dependencies

exact_diagnostics.status: DONE — twelve scoped elementary normalization/proof diagnostics

families.name: Constant shifts and quotient centering
families.interpretation: BoJ18a Lemma 6.24 needs a common shift/reference bound; the quotient normalization uses minus the supremum. I and J alone do not control constants.

families.name: Mass and the variational quotient
families.interpretation: Berman uses mass-V energy; the NA source uses normalized energy. Probability F_mu is invariant under constants, whereas literal E1_C additionally requires a reference upper bound.

families.name: Coercivity rescaling
families.interpretation: The J-to-infinity proof of BoJ18a Proposition 7.8 uses J^(-1/2), not J^(1/2). These values test the scaling arithmetic only.

families.name: The sign and absorption of a square-root term
families.interpretation: An integral lower bound gives F<=A-J+B sqrt(J). The plus term can be absorbed to obtain A+B^2/2-J/2; the printed minus term does not follow.

families.name: J scaling exponent
families.interpretation: The exact rational quadratic test satisfies Lemma 6.17. The actual proof uses derivative J=t^(-1) I and I>=(n+1)/n J; these algebraic cases do not prove the general estimate.

families.name: Envelope directional lower bound
families.interpretation: Corollary 6.32 needs phi+inf(tf), or phi-|t| norm(f)_infinity. For positive constant f and negative t the printed phi-t inf(f) exceeds the obstacle.

families.name: Berman squared-weight Ding sign
families.interpretation: Literal Berman v3 (3.1) has a positive logarithm. The constant-shift test forces a negative logarithm with -E/V under the displayed KE convention; no main theorem counterexample is claimed.

families.name: Deligne fibre degree and normalized energy
families.interpretation: Berman (2.4) needs n+1 curvatures; normalized energy differentiation needs 1/((n+1)V). The test concerns formal degree and constant-potential calibration.

families.name: Singular Kempf–Ness local weight
families.interpretation: For Phi=-l t and t=-log|tau|^2 the direct frame calculation verifies Lemma 2.6. An orbit section with nonzero weight has a zero or pole at zero.

families.name: Adjoint stability signs
families.interpretation: BoJ18b Corollary 5.17 uses A-S. The next semistability paragraph reverses both its inequality and formula. The zero-over-zero trivial valuation is excluded from ratios.

families.name: A rare linear weight and the FS regularization gate
families.interpretation: One linear weight among m+1 basis weights disappears in every fixed finite-p moment and remains in infinity distance. BoJ18b FS and Q explicitly include usc, so the raw point-jump example does not refute its Theorem 4.16.

families.name: Subalgebra degree period and lattice index
families.interpretation: For k[x^2,y^2] inside k[x,y], an ordinary all-degree volume limit fails and the ambient lattice gives the wrong leading coefficient on even degrees. Lemma 4.15 needs the applicable semigroup lattice and admissible degrees; no full replacement theorem is promoted.
